slides.heading: Status of Metro Extension
slides.text: About 70% of the viaduct of the Kochi metro’s 11.20-km Kakkanad extension (Pink Line) complete.

slides.text: 10 of the 11 stations will have entry/exit from both sides of the road beneath the upcoming metro extension.
